name: mgamadeus/ddd-agent-sandbox
description: Agent sandbox for mgamadeus/ddd: isolated runner sessions (gVisor, one session per pod), persistent workspaces with a pluggable store, project image and preload, administration with audit, and beside ddd-agents the agent's shell tools and document skills

suggest.mgamadeus/ddd-agents: ^0.3.2 — adds the agent's shell tools (agent.sandbox.shell), the skills Agent.Sandbox.Shell and Agent.Sandbox.Documents, the flush at a settled turn, the workspace activity of the admin screen and the eval participant
suggest.async-aws/s3: The object store of the built-in workspace store on S3-compatible storage
suggest.mgamadeus/ddd-clouddrive: ^0.3.1 — beside ddd-agents: the drive store (AI.Sandbox.workspaces.store = drive): the workspace of an agent space is the working copy of its own drive, the library space mounted below drivespaces/
